pattern.description: Live-action office shot where a defocused foreground figure crosses the lens, briefly occluding the subject, who is revealed again sipping from a branded mug.
pattern.why_premium: The defocused foreground pass adds depth and a natural, motivated wipe that makes the scene feel observed and cinematic rather than staged.

build_hint.gsap: Live footage, no tweened properties. For a motion-graphics recreation: a blurred foreground layer gsap.fromTo(fg, {xPercent: -60, filter: 'blur(24px)'}, {xPercent: 160, duration: 0.9, ease: 'none'}) over a static subject layer.
build_hint.remotion: <OffthreadVideo> in a <Sequence>; for a recreation, translateX = interpolate(frame, [0, 27], [-60, 160]) percent with a constant CSS blur on the foreground layer (linear, no spring).

notes: Camera verdict is none; motion is subjects inside the frame. The foreground passer-by has left the frame by the end frame, so b06 (right-edge residue) is the closest candidate; b03 may also capture its exit trail. Background woman (b04/b05/b08) shows only minor movement and was omitted.
